title: Koh Lanta vs Koh Phangan: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Koh Lanta for relaxed beaches, diving, and families. Koh Phangan for the Full Moon Party and yoga retreats. Check monsoon timing before choosing.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Koh Lanta's beaches are longer, quieter, and more consistently beautiful island-wide.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Full Moon Party (30,000-40,000 people) — Koh Phangan is unmatched for parties.

categories.name: Diving
categories.summary: Hin Daeng and Hin Muang rank among Thailand's finest dive sites.

categories.name: Wellness/Yoga
categories.summary: Koh Phangan is Southeast Asia's yoga retreat capital.

categories.name: Value
categories.summary: Slightly cheaper accommodation and fewer tourist traps.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Easier and cheaper access via Krabi budget airlines.

categories.name: Digital Nomads
categories.summary: Larger nomad community; Koh Lanta wins for productivity.

categories.name: Best Time
categories.summary: Opposite seasons — Koh Lanta best Nov-Apr, Koh Phangan best Dec-Feb and Jun-Aug.

faq.question: Is Koh Lanta or Koh Phangan better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Koh Lanta for a relaxed beach holiday; Koh Phangan for Full Moon Party or wellness retreats.

faq.question: Which is cheaper?
faq.answer: Comparable, with Koh Lanta slightly cheaper on accommodation — both ~฿700-1,200/day budget.

faq.question: Best time to visit?
faq.answer: Opposite seasonality — Koh Lanta best Nov-Apr (Andaman), Koh Phangan best Dec-Feb & Jun-Aug (Gulf).
